transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because I need help dealing with the people who have been following me. A specific group has been monitoring my every move and wiretapping my apartment for a long time now. I just don't know how to make them stop, and it's becoming too much to handle.
Besides noticing these people following you, have you heard any voices or seen things that other people don't seem to hear or see?

No, I haven't heard any unusual voices or seen things that aren't really there. I only see the actual people who are constantly following and monitoring me. It is definitely happening in the real world, not in my head.
How has your mood been during this time? Have you been feeling unusually down, or perhaps extremely energetic and active?
My mood has been pretty normal, to be honest. I haven't really felt unusually down or extremely energetic at all. Aside from being stressed about the people watching me, I feel like my usual self.
How has this situation affected your daily life, such as your ability to work, take care of yourself, or spend time with family and friends?

For the most part, my daily life is completely normal. I still go to work every day, manage my household, and see my friends and family without any real issues. It's just the constant stress of knowing I'm being watched that makes it hard to fully relax.

This rules out Schizophrenia and strongly supports a diagnosis of Delusional Disorder. Therefore, the only remaining candidate is Delusional Disorder, and we can finalize the diagnosis.
